title: Bump rust-cache action in status-block workflow
summary: A one-line dependency bump: the status-block GitHub Actions workflow now pins Swatinem/rust-cache to v2.9.3 (commit d1527c8) instead of v2.9.2. Nothing else in the workflow changes — the checkout, the release build of the osf tool, and the status-block job that consumes it all stay as they were. The only behavioural surface is the cache restore/save step that sits between checkout and the cargo build.
